changelog: Hid the owner's holding hand locally in Zoomed 3D view (while staying visible to nearby players) and removed all breathing tremble.
Optimized 3D DUI capture with viewport culling, motion-driven capture, and fast JPEG encoding with GPU corner clipping for smooth fluid interaction.
Fixed mouse wheel scrolling, edge Home bar hit-testing, and click/drag reliability in 3D view.
Added quick Home, Back, and Show Screen buttons directly to the 3D HUD bar and guaranteed Show Screen visibility on existing Android Quick Panels.
